    Class TpModal

    Modal overlay component.

    Displays centered content above the page, with optional backdrop and outside-click closing.

    Example

    <tp-modal></tp-modal>

    Tagname

    tp-modal

    Attr

    open = false - Opens the modal.

    Attr

    breakout = false - Allows the modal to ignore the default containment constraints.

    Attr

    margin = "" - Margin used when the modal is contained by the viewport.

    Attr

    fixed = false - Positions the modal relative to the viewport.

    Attr

    backdrop = false - Displays a backdrop behind the modal.

    Attr

    outside-click = false - Closes the modal when the user clicks outside it.

    tp-modal-toggle Emitted when the modal open state changes.

    Eventdetail

    tp-modal-toggle { backdrop: boolean; open: boolean; outsideClick: boolean; breakout: boolean; fixed: boolean }

    Cssprop

    --tp-modal-margin Margin used by the contained modal layout.

    Accessibility

    Exposes modal dialog semantics through role="dialog" and aria-modal="true".

    Accessibility

    Moves focus inside on opening, keeps focus inside, and restores focus on closing.

    Accessibility

    Makes content outside the modal inert while the modal is open.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Provide an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Provide a visible, clearly labeled control that closes the modal.

    Keyboard

    Moves to the next focusable control and wraps inside the modal.

    Keyboard

    Moves to the previous focusable control and wraps inside the modal.

    Keyboard

    Closes the modal.
